query:
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_visits, 
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as companies_still_exist,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as companies_missing
FROM leadinfo_visits lv
LEFT JOIN companies c ON c.id = lv.companyId
WHERE lv.searchId = 1680001;
